digest.component_or_area: metrics blame and bug-close causality derivation
propositions: _blame_file_commits currently returns [] both on git failure and on successful-but-empty blame, making failure and emptiness indistinguishable and preventing proper abort on failure.

derive_caused_by loops per-path and tallies results; if blame succeeds on some paths and fails on others, the strict-majority test runs over a subset and can elect a wrong culprit, writing an incorrect caused_by link.

_blame_file_commits must return None on git failure and [] on successful-but-empty blame; derive_caused_by must abort and return None when any path yields None, preventing partial-failure wrong answers.

Clone guidance documentation must record measured performance (full 1.04 GiB / 59 s vs blobless 68.7 MiB / 14.3 s), state that --filter=blob:none is the accepted degradation, and warn that --filter=tree:0 must never be used (3.57 GiB measured).
A legitimately empty file blame result must not abort derivation; only actual git failures abort.
With all paths succeeding, the derived culprit remains unchanged from the current implementation (negative control).
